correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 proves every superdominating complement has size 0, 1, or an auxiliary-graph edge under the exact hypotheses. Unordered partitions into two blocks have n+e forbidden splits; three blocks split disjointly into two singletons, singleton-plus-edge, or disjoint edges with the n=6 overcount correction; four blocks biject to triangles; five or more are impossible. Direct definition-based exhaustive enumeration covers all 24509 eligible six-vertex labelled graphs, plus 15 multipartite profiles and larger samples. The full proof is not inferred from this finite experiment.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete partition spectrum and partner-graph classification for all isolate-free graphs satisfying a natural minimum-superdomination bound, not only special families.
